If you’re asking about warranty coverage for defective items, here’s what I have for our warranties: 
Mattresses: Every mattress purchased directly from Endy.com is covered by a 10-year Limited Warranty by default. If you register as an Endy VIP, coverage extends to 15 years at no additional cost. Covered defects include:
Degradation causing a visible indentation greater than 1 inch (not associated with an improper foundation)
Physical flaws that cause the foam to split or crack despite normal usage and proper handling
For The Endy Mattress only: defects in the zipper assembly of the mattress cover (we may repair or replace the cover)
Not covered (mattresses):
Normal increase in softness over time
Comfort or height preference
Stains, burns, tears, cuts, or liquid/moisture damage from customer use or environment
Damage from an inappropriate foundation
Products sold by an unauthorized retailer or sold as “used”
For The Endy Hybrid Mattress only: damage to fabric handles due to improper handling
